newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: Botswana Telecom shortlists mobile phone partners.
newsitem.headline: Botswana Telecom shortlists mobile phone partners.

text.p: Botswana Telecommunications Corp (BTC) has earmarked two potential partners to bring in a cellular telephone service to the country.
Chief executive, Olebile Gaborone, told reporters that the two concerns had been identified in co-operation with international consultants, Price Waterhouse.

He said that out of nine applicants, four were asked to make presentations -- SBC Communications Inc, Telia of Sweden, Telekom Malaysia Bhd and Vodacom, a joint venture between Vodafone Plc and South African state-run utility Telkom.
Two of the four were shortlisted and are currently negotiating with BTC. They have not been named.
Two cellular network licences are due to be granted soon. BTC will bid for one with a joint venture partner.
